name: Traveler's Chosen

frame.name: Gathering Light
frame.description:
Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of Gathering Light.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Consume stacks, granting melee, grenade, and class ability energy based on the number of stacks.

perks.name: QuickDot SAS
perks.description:
Agile Sidearm sight. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Gift of the Traveler
perks.description: Each stack of Gathering Light improves this weapon's reload, handling, and target acquisition.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: "All we have left now is our faith."

catalyst.name: Traveler's Chosen Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.
Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.
